goldBurnRateMultiplier.label: Gold burn rate
goldBurnRateMultiplier.description: Scales how quickly Kingsmarch consumes treasury gold to pay workers (0 disables gold upkeep).

wageMultiplier.label: Worker wages
wageMultiplier.description: Scales hourly gold wages for recruited and assigned Kingsmarch workers.

miningSpeedMultiplier.label: Mining speed
miningSpeedMultiplier.description: Scales how fast Kingsmarch miners convert pending map ore into mined ore.

smeltingSpeedMultiplier.label: Smelting speed
smeltingSpeedMultiplier.description: Scales how fast Kingsmarch smelters convert mined ore into bars.

farmingSpeedMultiplier.label: Farming speed
farmingSpeedMultiplier.description: Scales crop growth speed across all Kingsmarch farm plots.

cropYieldMultiplier.label: Crop yield
cropYieldMultiplier.description: Scales the quantity of crops harvested per growth cycle.

disenchantingSpeedMultiplier.label: Disenchanting speed
disenchantingSpeedMultiplier.description: Scales how fast Rog and his assistants disenchant queued items into Thaumaturgic Dust.

dustYieldMultiplier.label: Thaumaturgic Dust yield
dustYieldMultiplier.description: Scales the amount of Thaumaturgic Dust gained from disenchanting and map dust encounters.

shippingSpeedMultiplier.label: Shipping speed
shippingSpeedMultiplier.description: Scales ship voyage travel speed between Kingsmarch and foreign ports.

shippingRiskMultiplier.label: Shipping risk
shippingRiskMultiplier.description: Scales voyage risk and shipping failure probability (0 disables shipment losses).

shippingRewardMultiplier.label: Shipping rewards
shippingRewardMultiplier.description: Scales item and currency rewards returned from completed shipments.

mappingSpeedMultiplier.label: Map runner speed
mappingSpeedMultiplier.description: Scales how quickly Kingsmarch Atlas runners complete queued maps.

mappingDeathChanceMultiplier.label: Map runner death chance
mappingDeathChanceMultiplier.description: Scales the chance of Kingsmarch map runners dying during map runs (0 disables runner deaths).

oreFoundMultiplier.label: Ore found
oreFoundMultiplier.description: Scales the quantity of ore claimed from map deposits and Refiner's Bargain conversions.

bossAmbushChanceMultiplier.label: Boss ambush chance
bossAmbushChanceMultiplier.description: Scales the chance of Admiral Valerius pirate ambushes, Sasan bandit ambushes, and Starfall Crater spawns.

offlineCatchupEnabled.label: Offline catch-up simulation
offlineCatchupEnabled.description: Simulates elapsed Kingsmarch mining, smelting, farming, disenchanting, shipping, and mapping time while offline.
